يستكثرا (form X)
# يَسْتَكْثِرَا (yastakṯirā) /jas.tak.θi.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# يُسْتَكْثَرَا (yustakṯarā) /jus.tak.θa.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
